required_reports: count and share in each bucket
average and median return within each bucket
share of total positive PnL from big wins
fee stress at 3 and 4 dollars per round trip

big_loss_tripwire.basis: 2 times the Charter's approximately 2 percent ceiling
big_loss_tripwire.minimum_evidence: At least 3 big-loss trades. With fewer, report descriptive_only unless the exact same trade breaches the daily or ruin gate.

four_bucket_profile.warning: The target 18/73/8/approximately-2 profile is a north star, not a fit target. No loss, threshold, reward, early stopping rule, or candidate rank may use bucket proximity.

harvest_ratio.evaluation_entries: Identical frozen entries for floor-on and learned-exit-without-floor.
harvest_ratio.eligible_trade: The causal peak available fee-adjusted PnL before forced flat is strictly positive.
harvest_ratio.aggregate: sum(realized_fee_adjusted_net_pnl over eligible trades) / sum(peak_available_fee_adjusted_net_pnl over eligible trades)
harvest_ratio.paired_session_delta: aggregate contribution floor_on minus aggregate contribution floor_off, computed from identical entries and summarized by session
required_reports: median and quantiles of per-trade ratio
paired session-block-bootstrap 95% interval for floor-on minus floor-off

collapse_definition.statistical_condition: The paired session-block-bootstrap 95% upper confidence bound for floor_on minus floor_off is below zero.

harvest_ratio.floor_off_not_positive: Report lifecycle_no_harvestable_tail rather than calling a floor-collapse tripwire.

relationship_to_hard_gates.g4_daily_ruin: Always hard and evaluated separately. A tripwire can never rescue a G4, daily-stop, or ruin failure.
relationship_to_hard_gates.entry_acceptance: Profile shape cannot rescue failed whole-path entry evidence.
relationship_to_hard_gates.lifecycle_acceptance: Harvest collapse pauses for owner review even if ordinary lifecycle metrics pass.
